category: discovery layer over the public Mainline DHT, published from an iroh node the user runs

free_tier.stated: No quota, no storage. Pure discovery: publishes BLAKE3->provider mappings onto the public BitTorrent Mainline DHT.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: UDP DHT traffic only, kilobytes. Mainline lookups measured at 37 ms in n0's own example.

tooling: Publishes a signed endpoint record (endpoint id + UDP socket + timestamp) to a tiny UDP address-index service, then `announce_peer` for SHA-1(BLAKE3 hash). Discovery returns candidate EndpointIds which are then dialled with normal iroh hole punching.
chaining: Removes the last central dependency: no DNS, no pkarr relay, no account. Requires at least one reachable address-index service, found by rendezvous hash or a curated BEP 44 record.
limits_note: Mainline traffic is unencrypted and 'easily blocked by middleboxes'; no privacy ('anybody can look up your ip address'); the address-index service is last-writer-wins, in-memory, and records expire — publishers must re-announce on a schedule.
reliability_note: Experimental repo (12 stars, last push 2026-10-16). SHA-1 is used only as a keyspace key, so a malicious DHT answer can waste time but cannot corrupt data — verification is against the BLAKE3 root.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: announce/discovery workflow, udp-addr-index rationale, 37 ms lookup, 'mainline does not provide any privacy'
